bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/forms.rs (TextField), springboard/ui/src/text.rs (TextBuffer marked range), springboard/proto/src/lib.rs (ToApp 60-63, TextState, CaretRect, InputTraits), springboard/src/shell/textinput.rs (composition mapping, popup_origin), springboard/src/shell/keyboard.rs (Composition), springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (text input Ctx hooks)
summary: BifrOSt covers the client side of composition: an app text field draws marked text, reports its caret and text state to the shell, and takes SetMarkedText/UnmarkText from the on-screen keyboard. It has no input method provider side (no IMKServer, IMKInputController or candidates window), so a third-party IME cannot run, and nothing draws a candidate popup yet.

features.note: Wave 4 (theme-17, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell serves no wl_seat text-input or input_method, so a provider process has nothing to connect to.

Wave 4 (theme-17, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No base class that receives one controller per client input session.

gaps: No input method provider: no IMKServer, IMKInputController or input method registration (springboard/src/shell/textinput.rs header).
No candidates window (IMKCandidates); popup_origin in springboard/src/shell/textinput.rs only places a popup, and nothing draws it.
The keyboard app does not send Preedit yet (springboard/apps/keyboard), so composition is not produced by anything in practice.
No IMKServerInput event routing (inputText, didCommand, handle) through a provider; no composedString, originalString or candidates queries.
No IMKMouseHandling hook and no IMKStateSetting input-mode state.
